title: Write an eval that catches regression
brief: A change to project guidance removes caching from a live-status feature. Happy-path tests pass, but the old claims system exceeds its rate limit. Build a repeatable evaluation that catches the regression without rejecting valid refactors.
acceptance: The good reference and equivalent valid refactor pass.
Missing cache, rate-limit breach and payload logging are detected.
Assertions inspect behavior rather than file names or fixture IDs.
The eval includes repeatable input, requirement references and documented checks.
